placesHero.title: Places we know well
placesHero.body: The towns, hills, parks and beaches our journeys pass through, what each one is really for, and the months it is at its best.
placesHero.alt: Sigiriya rock rising out of the forest

placesMap.heading: Five parts of one small island.
placesMap.lede: Each region has its own weather and its own season. Pick one to see where it sits, and the places below narrow to match.
placesMap.blurb: Two monsoons take turns, so some part of the island is always in season. Pick a region to see its months.

placeRegions.name: Hill Country
placeRegions.blurb: Tea estates, cool mornings and the train line. Where we put the early starts.

placeRegions.name: Cultural Triangle
placeRegions.blurb: Rock fortresses, cave temples and ancient cities, best seen before the heat of the day.

placeRegions.name: South and west coast
placeRegions.blurb: Fort towns, whale bays and long beaches, at their calmest through the northern winter.

placeRegions.name: East coast
placeRegions.blurb: Calm water and empty beaches in the months the south is wet.

placeRegions.name: National parks
placeRegions.blurb: Leopards, elephants and birds, planned around the hours the animals are out.
